objective: Find the smallest reproducible language model that enters a frozen SOTA band on coding and engineering tasks, while serving as the natural-language cross-domain validation of NewEra.

claim.display: smallest reproducible two-stage AST-first coding/engineering model in the declared compact SOTA Pareto band
literal_world_sota_requires: all reproducible baselines under the declared parameter and data protocol
a parameter count including embeddings and all adapters
independent reproduction of the winning run
forbidden_before_certification: superiority over public large coding models
SOTA-level engineering ability from code-generation scores alone
parameter or data scaling as the primary contribution

anti_scaling_contract.generated_expert_mode: reallocate capacity inside the declared tier
anti_scaling_contract.large_model_comparison_policy: reference only; never a headline matched baseline
forbidden_strategies: adding generic transformer layers after every failed screen
increasing the model cap to chase GPT-class benchmarks
ensembling multiple models in the primary endpoint
counting only active parameters while hiding total resident parameters

parameter_ladder.purpose: diagnostic upper bound only; never used for the primary smallest-model claim

hard_guards.failure_action: Any structured JSON failure blocks all C1-C4 coding/engineering claims.

engineering_ability.definition: Generate, modify, or diagnose code against executable tests, compiler/runtime checks, and bounded performance criteria.
required_tasks: multi-file Python repair with unit tests
Triton kernel generation checked by numerical equivalence
Linux process/memory/I/O diagnosis with deterministic expected actions
performance patch with correctness and latency guard
forbidden_shortcuts: keyword matching as the only engineering metric

sota_band.definition: A model enters the bounded SOTA band only if it is non-dominated in the declared low-capability parameter/compute class and within the frozen tolerance of the best reproducible model in that class.
sota_band.matched_comparator: same corpus family, tokenizer, training tokens, context, and evaluator
required_reported_baselines: nearest available public coding model above the cap, reported only as an out-of-class reference

promotion_ladder.claim: The generated infrastructure trains and evaluates without leakage.
promotion_ladder.required: protocol, tokenizer, executor, and baseline smoke pass

promotion_ladder.claim: The candidate beats a matched from-scratch control on at least one preregistered coding or engineering track.
The candidate is a non-dominated point on the parameter-capability frontier.
promotion_ladder.required: scaling ladder and nearest public baseline comparison

promotion_ladder.claim: The candidate enters the frozen SOTA band.
promotion_ladder.required: all primary tracks within the frozen tolerance with no material language-retention regression

promotion_ladder.claim: The candidate is the smallest reproducible SOTA-band model at the certification snapshot.
promotion_ladder.required: independent rerun, frozen leaderboard snapshot, complete baseline ledger, and three training seeds

specialization_order: Freeze AST schemas, parsers, benchmark fixtures, and executable evaluators before model changes.
Run matched one-stage and two-stage CFM controls before task specialization.
Train a train-only code-aware tokenizer and audit compression on Python, Rust, C++, Triton, and Linux text.
Run the unchanged control and hierarchy candidate at P2M to validate the training stack.
Run the P5M and P12M matched scaling screens; stop specialization if capability remains flat.
Add fill-in-the-middle, code diff, and test/compiler feedback objectives at the smallest surviving scale.
Add Triton and Linux engineering tasks after code-generation and repo-patch gates pass.
Open P23M only if P5M/P12M fail the frozen capability band; P46M is a non-claim diagnostic.
Run test opening and independent reproduction only after C2 passes.
evidence_boundary: This config defines the target and claim ladder. It does not establish coding or engineering SOTA.
